classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design a protein sequence that exhibits ATP binding, NADPHX epimerase activity, metal ion binding, and ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity. Mg(2+) is necessary. Return an output protein sequence.
assumptions: Target protein belongs to the NAXE/NAXD (NADPHX repair enzyme) family, which carries both epimerase and ADP-dependent dehydratase activities in a single polypeptide and requires Mg2+ as cofactor.
No seed sequence or structural scaffold is provided; workflow will retrieve reviewed family members via literature-grounded GO annotation and return the top-ranked representative sequence.

GO:0034719 (NADPHX epimerase activity) is used as the primary retrieval term; ATP binding (GO:0005524) and metal ion binding (GO:0046872) are co-annotated on members of this family and will be confirmed during sequence analysis.
Reviewed (Swiss-Prot) entries are preferred to maximize annotation reliability; max_sequences capped at 100 to keep runtime bounded.

Output sequence is the representative candidate returned by sequence_analysis from the retrieved FASTA; further structural validation (folding, QC, ranking) is deferred to a subsequent round if an explicit in-silico structure is required.
Provider selected a workflow template that does not match the available request inputs; canonicalized to the validated local template.
